approval.rationale: Promotes the existing exact Catalog.record_run ingestion-row replacement from a fingerprint exemption to a reviewed contract without changing its destructive surface.

identity.name: Catalog ingestion-run recording v1
identity.purpose: Publish or replace the complete ingestion_runs evidence row for one concrete RunManifest run_id inside one DuckDB transaction.

implementation_bindings.rationale: Catalog.record_run owns one exact-run-id DELETE followed by publication of that run's complete ingestion evidence row.

initiators: MarketVault service paths that hold one complete RunManifest with a concrete run_id
authority_boundary.mutation_owner: src/market_vault/storage/catalog.py Catalog.record_run for the exact manifest.run_id
forbidden_bypass_layers: Callers must not use Catalog.record_run as a generic ingestion_runs deletion API
Catalog.record_run must not accept wildcard or multi-run deletion scope
Catalog.record_run must not mutate physical artifacts or unrelated Catalog tables

mutated_assets: The single ingestion_runs row whose run_id exactly equals the supplied complete RunManifest run_id
excluded_assets: All ingestion_runs rows with another run_id
market_bar_snapshot_pairs, quality_results, dataset_ingestion_runs, and purge_operations rows
Parquet files, manifests, reports, Canonical artifacts, and Dataset artifacts
Safe Purge state, quarantine contents, garbage collection, and permanent deletion

allowed_transitions.rationale: The exact old row is replaced by the complete current row when the DuckDB transaction commits.
A transaction error prevents publication and leaves no partially committed replacement.
A caller may retry publication for the same exact run_id with complete current run evidence.

forbidden_transitions.rationale: A committed row is not exposed as a partially reopened mutation.
A later caller failure does not retroactively make a committed DuckDB transaction partial.

commit_point.durable_authority: The successful DuckDB transaction commit containing the complete replacement ingestion_runs row for the exact manifest.run_id.
commit_point.success_authoritative_when: The transaction has committed the caller's complete current run evidence at the same exact run_id.

pre_commit: DuckDB transaction rollback prevents a committed half-replacement or partially inserted new row.
Failure before commit does not authorize deletion of any other ingestion run or artifact.
post_commit: The complete row at the exact run_id is authoritative after commit.
A retry remains confined to replacement of that same exact run_id.

restorable: Before commit, DuckDB transaction rollback restores the prior committed Catalog state.
non_restorable: No filesystem restore, artifact restore, or permanent deletion operation is part of this contract.
interruption_detection: A transaction exception is non-success and must not be reported as a committed replacement.

same_request_retry: Repeated publication may replace only the row with the same concrete run_id using the caller's complete current run evidence.
completed_retry: Re-publishing complete evidence for the same exact run_id is permitted and must leave unrelated rows unchanged.
conflicting_retry: A request for a different run_id is a separate exact-row publication and cannot delete or replace the previously addressed row.

lock_authority: Catalog.record_run relies on its DuckDB transaction and the existing caller lifecycle authority where the product design already requires one.
lock_scope: This contract does not create a new external lock or broaden existing market-bar lifecycle locking semantics.
under_lock_revalidation: The caller supplies one concrete, complete RunManifest and Catalog.record_run binds mutation to its exact run_id.
concurrent_behavior: DuckDB transaction failure is reported as non-success; this contract does not authorize a bypass or broader retry scope.

identities: The concrete RunManifest run_id and the complete row values being published for that run
drift_behavior: The method may replace only the exact row addressed by manifest.run_id and must not expand scope through wildcard or unrelated identifiers.

authoritative_evidence: A committed ingestion_runs row at the exact manifest.run_id containing the caller's complete current run evidence
non_success_evidence: An exception, rolled-back transaction, in-memory manifest, or uncommitted row
integrity_binding: The transaction binds deletion and insertion to one exact run_id and commits the complete replacement row atomically.

unverifiable_path_policy.rationale: No path is accepted as a mutation target by this operation.

invalidation_triggers.rationale: This internal Catalog publication has no user-reviewed plan or Console preview.

confirmation_invalidation.rationale: This operation exposes no destructive confirmation UI.

execution_policy.rationale: This contract authorizes only internal exact-run-id record publication, not an external destructive command.

lifecycle_unit: One complete ingestion_runs row identified by one exact run_id
partial_mutation: The DELETE and replacement INSERT must commit in one DuckDB transaction; a half-replacement is non-success.
rollback_expectation: A pre-commit failure rolls back the transaction and must not affect unrelated rows.

retained_dependents: All unrelated Catalog rows and all filesystem artifacts remain outside this exact-row mutation.
refused_cases: Wildcard deletion, unrelated run IDs, incomplete row publication, and mutation of another Catalog table are outside this authority.
unsupported_cases: Deletion of market_bar_snapshot_pairs, quality_results, dataset_ingestion_runs, purge_operations, Parquet, manifests, reports, Canonical, or Dataset artifacts
Safe Purge, garbage collection, cascade cleanup, and permanent deletion

permanent_deletion.rationale: The exact old ingestion_runs row is replaced transactionally by complete current evidence for the same run_id; this contract exposes no permanent-delete operation.

implementation_tests: Repository inventory assigns Catalog.record_run destructive_sql sql.DELETE_FROM expected_count 1 to this contract and to no exemption
Repeated recording replaces only the same exact run_id and leaves unrelated ingestion_runs rows unchanged
A transaction failure does not commit a half-replacement
No additional DELETE, DROP, TRUNCATE, filesystem deletion, Safe Purge, or wildcard surface is authorized
